summary: Sente is a G$ (GoodDollar) gifting app on Celo: anyone can send GoodDollar to a wallet with a short note, like sending a small gift instead of a cold transfer. This first milestone ships the real interface and a fully working local demo of the send flow (no on-chain payments yet), for anyone with the link.
direction: Warm wooded editorial: the forest palette already in the tokens (off-white green-tinted background, deep forest green, white paper cards) with a serif display face (Fraunces) over a round geometric sans (DM Sans), generous space, 24px rounded "gift card" surfaces with hairline borders and a faint leaf-blob wash behind the hero; the mood of a handwritten note tucked into paper, calm and human, neve

pages.purpose: Home and the send screen: explain the app in one line and let someone compose a G$ gift locally.
elements: Layout top bar: app mark (a small leaf glyph in a green rounded square) + wordmark "Sente", nav links Home / Activity / About, ConnectButton on the right; below
Hero: eyebrow chip "GoodDollar on Celo", headline "Send G$ like a gift, not a transaction.", one-sentence subline about sending GoodDollar with a note to any wa
Send panel (the hero's right-hand card, overlapping slightly on wide screens, full width on phone): a labelled Recipient input (label "Recipient" with the place
Primary button whose label follows the amount, e.g. "Send 10 G$" or "Send 25 G$ after typing; pressing it with no recipient shows a danger Notice "Add a recipie
A persistent sky-toned info Notice inside the panel: "Demo mode: nothing leaves your wallet yet. Gifts made here are saved on this device only."
On a valid send: a success Notice reading "Demo gift recorded. G$ transfers turn on soon." and the gift is appended to local demo history; the form keeps the no
"How it works" band (bg-primary, three short numbered steps: pick a recipient, write a note, send G$) with the last step marked "coming soon"
Demo history strip: the two most recent local demo gifts with amount, note and short recipient, plus a link "See all gifts" to /activity, and a friendly empty s
Footer: short line about G$ on Celo, links to Activity and About

pages.purpose: Shows every G$ gift composed on this device (local demo history).
elements: Page heading "Gifts you've sent" with a line explaining these are demo gifts stored on this device
RefreshButton-style "Clear demo gifts" outline button (with a confirm dialog) when there is at least one entry
List of gift rows from local storage: amount in G$, note, short recipient address, relative time ("just now", "5 min ago")
Empty state card: a leaf icon, "No gifts yet", a line inviting the visitor to compose one, and a Link button "Send your first G$" back to /
Summary row: count of demo gifts and total G$ value, labelled demo

pages.purpose: Explains G$, Sente and what this milestone can and cannot do yet.
elements: Eyebrow and heading "What is G$?" plus two short paragraphs: GoodDollar is a free-to-earn currency on Celo, Sente is a way to pass a little of it on with a note
Four honest status cards: "Interface ready", "Demo gifts on this device", "Sending G$ goes live in the next milestone" and "Built on Celo"
Accordion FAQ: "What is GoodDollar?", "Do I need a wallet to try the demo?", "Where do my demo gifts go?", "When will real G$ transfers work?"
Closing band with a Link button back to the send screen
